$comment: One entry per school. `dark` is the deep brand color that carries the editor chrome;
`accent` is the bright brand color used for highlights, keywords, and the cursor.
Omit `dark` and the generator derives a deep, low-chroma tint from `accent` instead —
correct for schools whose only brand color is bright (Tennessee, Texas, Ohio State).
`source` records where the hex values were verified. Add a school by appending an object
and running `npm run build`; nothing else needs to change.

schools.label: Georgia Bulldogs
schools.source: teamcolorcodes.com — Bulldog Red PMS 200 C, Arch Black. Red leads, so the chrome derives from it rather than from black.
